actions.message:
[Shield] Bernadotte stands firm against superior numbers! (Cautious: +10% outnumbered)
[Combat] Adjacent allies bolster ArchdukeCharles's attack! (+4%)
ArchdukeCharles engages in solid combat. ArchdukeCharles gains the advantage over Bernadotte. Casualties: ArchdukeCharles 483, Bernadotte 2,472. Both armies remain in the field.

[!] Bernadotte's troops are BROKEN (morale 25%)! FORCED RETREAT! Franconia has been captured by Austria!
[!] Bernadotte's broken army flees to Dresden! (14 lost to march) (recovering for 3 turns)

battle_report.observation: Bernadotte's army has been badly mauled. ArchdukeCharles proved the stronger force today.

actions.message:
[Square broken — Mack breaks formation to attacks]

[Combat] Adjacent allies bolster Mack's attack! (+2%)
Mack's forces advance steadily. Mack gains the advantage over Ney. Casualties: Mack 3,066, Ney 5,816. Both armies remain in the field. Mack advances into Rhineland. (1,421 lost to march)
Soult withdraws to Lorraine after the battle.

battle_report.observation: Soult arrived to reinforce Ney! The timely arrival swung the battle in our favor, Sire.

actions.message:
